description: GSC query x page dataset (plus query x country, query x device, search appearance) for window W1

gsc_query_country_W1.csv.truncation_reason: hit 5000-row cap for this dataset with hasMore still true at startRow 5000

gsc_query_device_W1.csv.truncation_reason: hit 5000-row cap for this dataset with hasMore still true at startRow 5000

blockers.reason: invalid_request from the GSC MCP tool when dimensions=['searchAppearance','page'] (confirmed on 2 attempts, with and without startRow). No C_W1_appearance_page*.jsonl produced and no corresponding CSV built -- this is a hard API rejection, not a row-count truncation.

anonymized_query_share.method: Sum clicks/impressions across all query x page rows (dataset C, 6474 rows, untruncated) vs. property-wide totals for the same W1 window from one extra dimensions=['date'] call (28 daily rows, summed).
anonymized_query_share.note: query x page is not itself capped/truncated (6474 < 15000), so this gap is Google's anonymized/low-volume query omission, not our pagination cap.

row_key_format: W1|<dim1>|<dim2>... matching the dimensions array order used for that file's GSC call
